arrive.text: The long way home with your friend, along the boardwalk through the swamp.

strike_1.text: Lightning. It takes your friend apart, all of them, in an instant.

strike_2.text: And by sheer chance, at the same moment, it turns the dead tree into an exact copy of your friend. Every atom in place. Every memory.

seems.text: It seems to know you. It seems to remember. But a minute ago, it was a tree.

again.text: The storm's coming round again. There's another dead tree, just off the path.

dog.text: The dog wags its tail at you. It won't go near your friend.

frogs.text: Two frogs on the lily pad, where there used to be one. They look at each other.

home_idle.text: Your friend takes your arm, and walks you home.

home_1.text: You go in together. Your friend knows where the mugs are, and that you take two sugars.

home_2.text: Nobody will ever know the difference. Did your friend remember you? Or only seem to?
